documentary.title: The Macon Farm
documentary.byline: A documentary by Nathan Bradshaw & Mason Oehlrich
documentary.text: For generations, 300 acres of North Carolina farmland have held more than crops and barns—they have held a family’s history. From a decades-long feud that divided the farm in two, to Grandma Macon’s early-morning work in the dairy and the traditions she passed down, every corner of the land carries a story. After years of abandonment, the family returned to restore the property, turning forgotten barns and painful memories into a place filled with music, laughter, and gatherings. Today, the farm is still alive. Local farmers work its fields, generations of family return to celebrate, and the land remains home to the wildlife that has always been there. But as development pressures grow, the family faces a new question: What will become of this land, and how can its story continue? A story about family, memory, and the land that connects generations.
